_finding: simulate_buy on the site (docs/simulate-buy-tz.md §1, §2 step 3, §5.3, §5.4): it costs 10 units, 15 with a wallet, over HTTP and MCP; the wallet never travels in a URL, so a GET that carries one is refused; the wallet is never written to the app's log; and a passport is built from the registry read the verdict was decided against, or not at all. A busy refund goes back to its own charge.

mutations.name: the route's units are set to 1
mutations.find: if (await limitGate(req, res, { units: simulateUnits(p.input), cors: SIM_HEADERS, charge })) return
mutations.replace: if (await limitGate(req, res, { units: 1, cors: SIM_HEADERS, charge })) return
mutations.expect: FAIL ...and on the route: six calls a free minute

mutations.name: the MCP units are set to 1
a GET with wallet is accepted
mutations.find: if (url.searchParams.has('wallet')) return send(res, 400, { error: WALLET_IN_URL }, undefined, SIM_HEADERS)
mutations.expect: FAIL a GET with wallet is refused with the 400 that says why

mutations.name: the wallet is written to the app's log
mutations.replace: const p = parseSimulate(raw, { fromText }); log('[simulate] ' + JSON.stringify(raw))
mutations.expect: FAIL the wallet address does not appear in the app's log

mutations.name: the passport is read from a second registry snapshot
mutations.find: if (snap && snap !== reg) return { status: 503, body: { error: 'the issuer list was read again while answering; ask again', chain } }

mutations.name: a refund goes to the current second
mutations.find: const i = charge.sec % RATE_WINDOW_S, back = Math.min(units, charge.units, b.slots[i])
mutations.replace: const i = sec % RATE_WINDOW_S, back = Math.min(units, b.slots[i])
mutations.expect: FAIL a busy refund goes back to the second of its own charge

mutations.name: a spill-window charge gets no refund
mutations.expect: FAIL ...and a caller counted in a shared spill window
